---
title: "Sampling map (Figure 1)"
format: html
---

```{r 01_map_chunk_01, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("scripts/00_source.R"))
```

```{r map_setup}

# Convert and enrich points
ohia_points <- meta_data %>%
  filter(shortname == "Ohia", island == "Oahu") %>%
  filter(!is.na(coord_x) & !is.na(coord_y)) %>%
  mutate(
    lon = coord_y,
    lat = coord_x,
    elevation_m = elevation_ft * 0.3048
  )

# Convert to sf points
ohia_sf <- ohia_points %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Tree host palette used across project figures
tree_palette <- c(
  "ʻōhiʻa lehua" = "#C1133D",
  "koa" = "#8B4513",
  "strawberry guava" = "gold"
)

# Ridge legend metadata (Δelev only)
ridge_legend_meta <- ohia_points %>%
  group_by(sample_site) %>%
  summarise(
    delta_elev_m = round(max(elevation_m, na.rm = TRUE) - min(elevation_m, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ridge_order <- c("ʻAiea", "Kaʻala", "Mānana", "Poamoho", "Schofield-Waikāne")
ridge_colors <- setNames(ggsci::pal_npg("nrc")(10)[1:5], ridge_order)
ridge_labels <- ridge_legend_meta %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(sample_site, " (\u0394elev=", delta_elev_m, " m)")) %>%
  select(sample_site, label) %>%
  tibble::deframe()

# Ridge anchor points (true site locations)
ridge_anchor <- ohia_points %>%
  group_by(sample_site) %>%
  summarise(
    ridge_lon = median(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
    ridge_lat = median(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Hardcoded icon layout for cleaner publication placement
site_icons <- tribble(
  ~sample_site,           ~species,              ~icon_lon,  ~icon_lat,
  "Kaʻala",               "ʻōhiʻa lehua",        -158.1920,  21.5100,
  "Schofield-Waikāne",    "ʻōhiʻa lehua",        -157.8900,  21.5300,
  "Poamoho",              "ʻōhiʻa lehua",        -157.9500,  21.5650,
  "Mānana",               "ʻōhiʻa lehua",        -157.9630,  21.4500,
  "Mānana",               "koa",                 -157.9410,  21.4500,
  "Mānana",               "strawberry guava",    -157.9520,  21.4680,
  "ʻAiea",                "ʻōhiʻa lehua",        -157.8510,  21.3710,
  "ʻAiea",                "koa",                 -157.8290,  21.3710,
  "ʻAiea",                "strawberry guava",    -157.8400,  21.3890
) %>%
  mutate(
    image_path = case_when(
      species == "ʻōhiʻa lehua" ~ here::here("data", "images", "ohia.png"),
      species == "koa" ~ here::here("data", "images", "koa.png"),
      TRUE ~ here::here("data", "images", "sberry.png")
    )
  )

icon_group_centers <- site_icons %>%
  group_by(sample_site) %>%
  summarise(
    group_lon = mean(icon_lon),
    group_lat = mean(icon_lat),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

leader_lines <- ridge_anchor %>%
  left_join(icon_group_centers, by = "sample_site")

# Build ridge tracks
ridge_lines <- ohia_points %>%
  arrange(sample_site, elevation_m) %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_split(sample_site) %>%
  map(~ {
    coords <- dplyr::select(.x, lon, lat) %>% as.matrix()
    st_linestring(coords)
  })

ridge_groups <- ohia_points %>%
  arrange(sample_site, elevation_m) %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_split(sample_site)

ridge_names <- ohia_points %>%
  arrange(sample_site, elevation_m) %>%
  pull(sample_site) %>%
  raster::unique()

ridge_lines <- ridge_groups %>%
  map(~ {
    coords <- dplyr::select(.x, lon, lat) %>% as.matrix()
    st_linestring(coords)
  })

ohia_tracks <- st_sf(
  sample_site = ridge_names,
  geometry = st_sfc(ridge_lines),
  crs = 4326
)

# Start and end elevation labels
elev_labels <- ohia_points %>%
  group_by(sample_site) %>%
  filter(elevation_m == min(elevation_m) | elevation_m == max(elevation_m)) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(round(elevation_m), " m")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Load Hawaiʻi outline
hawaii_outline <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(country = "United States of America", returnclass = "sf") %>%
  filter(name == "Hawaii")

# Use bounding box from the island outline directly and buffer it
bbox_raw <- st_bbox(hawaii_outline)
bbox_raw[c("xmin", "ymin")] <- bbox_raw[c("xmin", "ymin")] - 0.1
bbox_raw[c("xmax", "ymax")] <- bbox_raw[c("xmax", "ymax")] + 0.1
bbox_sf <- st_as_sf(st_as_sfc(bbox_raw))


# Elevation raster used for the manuscript map.
elev_clipped <- raster::raster(here::here("data", "oahu_elevation_clipped.tif"))

# Raster to df for plotting
elev_df <- as.data.frame(rasterToPoints(elev_clipped))
colnames(elev_df) <- c("x", "y", "elevation")
summary(elev_df$elevation)

# Final plot
map_core <- ggplot() +
  # elevation background
  geom_tile(data = elev_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = elevation)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "black", guide = "none") +
  new_scale_fill() +
  # outline and ridges
  geom_sf(data = hawaii_outline, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = ohia_tracks, aes(color = sample_site), linewidth = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ridge_colors, guide = "none") +
  # elevation labels
  geom_label_repel(
    data = elev_labels,
    aes(x = coord_y, y = coord_x, label = label),
    #stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    seed = 42,
    color = "black",
    fill = "white",
    segment.color = "black",
    segment.size = 0.55,
    min.segment.length = 0.1,
    label.size = 0.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    force = 2
  ) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  # leader lines for icon groups
  geom_curve(
    data = leader_lines,
    aes(x = ridge_lon, y = ridge_lat, xend = group_lon, yend = group_lat),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    curvature = 0.08,
    linewidth = 0.30,
    color = "grey45"
  ) +
  # sampling icons and annotations
  geom_point(
    data = site_icons,
    aes(x = icon_lon, y = icon_lat),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.25,
    size = 5.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = site_icons,
    aes(x = icon_lon, y = icon_lat, color = species),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "white",
    stroke = 1.05,
    size = 5.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_image(
    data = site_icons,
    aes(x = icon_lon, y = icon_lat, image = image_path),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    by = "width",
    size = 0.042,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = tree_palette,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-158.3, -157.6), ylim = c(21.25, 21.71), expand = FALSE) +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.2) +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "tl", which_north = "true",
                         style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering) +
  labs(title = NULL, color = "Ridge",
       x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )

# Bottom legend helpers
legend_cfg <- tibble(tree_circle_size = 7.0, tree_ring_stroke = 1.05, tree_png_size = 0.31)

build_map_with_legend <- function(cfg) {
  tree_legend_panel <- tibble(
    species = c("ʻōhiʻa lehua", "koa", "strawberry guava"),
    image_path = c(
      here::here("data", "images", "ohia.png"),
      here::here("data", "images", "koa.png"),
      here::here("data", "images", "sberry.png")
    ),
    label_html = c(
      "<i>Metrosideros polymorpha</i><br>(ʻōhiʻa lehua)",
      "<i>Acacia koa</i><br>(koa)",
      "<i>Psidium cattleyanum</i><br>(waiawī)"
    ),
    x = c(40, 98, 156),
    y = 2.16
  )

  # Two aligned ridge columns across both rows (fixes column offset drift)
  ridge_col_x <- c(40, 96, 152)
  ridge_legend_panel <- tribble(
    ~sample_site,           ~row_id, ~col_id,
    "ʻAiea",                      1,       1,
    "Kaʻala",                     1,       2,
    "Mānana",                     1,       3,
    "Poamoho",                    2,       1,
    "Schofield-Waikāne",          2,       2
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      sample_site = factor(sample_site, levels = ridge_order),
      x = ridge_col_x[col_id],
      y = if_else(row_id == 1, 1.04, 0.64),
      label = ridge_labels[as.character(sample_site)]
    )

  legend_plot <- ggplot() +
    geom_text(aes(x = 1.2, y = 2.16, label = "Sampled trees"), hjust = 0, size = 3.7) +
    geom_point(
      data = tree_legend_panel,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      shape = 21,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.25,
      size = cfg$tree_circle_size
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = tree_legend_panel,
      aes(x = x, y = y, color = species),
      shape = 21,
      fill = "white",
      stroke = cfg$tree_ring_stroke,
      size = cfg$tree_circle_size,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_image(
      data = tree_legend_panel,
      aes(x = x, y = y, image = image_path),
      by = "height",
      size = cfg$tree_png_size
    ) +
    ggtext::geom_richtext(
      data = tree_legend_panel,
      aes(x = x + 6.1, y = y, label = label_html),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 2.55,
      fill = NA,
      label.color = NA,
      label.padding = grid::unit(rep(0, 4), "pt")
    ) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 1.2, y = 0.86, label = "Ridge"), hjust = 0, size = 3.7) +
    geom_segment(
      data = ridge_legend_panel,
      aes(x = x - 1.5, xend = x + 0.4, y = y, yend = y, color = sample_site),
      linewidth = 1.6
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = ridge_legend_panel,
      aes(x = x + 1.6, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 2.65
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(tree_palette, ridge_colors), guide = "none") +
    xlim(0, 200) +
    ylim(0.30, 2.50) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(0, 6, 0, 6)
    )

  map_core / legend_plot + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(13, 2.6))
}

map <- build_map_with_legend(legend_cfg)

map
```

```{r save-map}
save_fig(
  tag = "F1_date_map",
  plot = map,
  which = "main",
  prefix = "none",
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)
```
